policy.scope: One verified participant/source repository and the same complete source-record identity.
policy.membership: The selected record version's targets are the record's current outputs, its output membership included; selection is never a maximum taken independently for each output. An output missing from a later version is not a retraction tombstone.
policy.selection: lifecycle.active.versionSelection: drop every version that another version beats with a greater writer version under the same complete writer-record pair; of the rest, select the latest Provenance.recorded as an exact instant; equal instants select the bytewise-greater record-version Identifier value, then system. A different writer identity or absent writer evidence leaves the order to recorded.
policy.equivalence: The same record-version Identifier with the same lossless tokens is an exact retry. Any other content, the same source content converted again included, is a distinct version. This receiver policy never infers source-content equality across versions by stripping graph fields.
policy.history: Every accepted version stays in history; advancing the current selection never removes one.
policy.authorization: Only the listed exact output versions are authorized. Current selection never carries a previous version's grant forward.
